# TopologyPreservation

**Domain**: TCC

## Definition
A speciation constraint that maintains structural diversity of circuit graphs during evolution, preventing loss of unique connectivity patterns. Preserves potentially useful network motifs that could enable emergent computational properties in topology-centric systems.
